root_causes: Misinterpretation of the 'new chest of drawers' requirement: all toy food items were repeatedly placed on chest_of_drawers_36 instead of distributing them to distinct, unused chests (e.g., 37, 38, 40).
Goal coverage was incomplete: the agents never addressed the toy_fire_truck_0 or stuffed_toy_4 subgoals, leaving 1/5 propositions unfinished despite ample steps.
Poor high-level task scheduling: the planner focused almost exclusively on toy food rearrangements and never reallocated effort to remaining objects once progress on food items was sufficient.
Inefficient coordination and idle behavior: Agent 0 spent the late phase in repeated Wait actions while still holding toy_food_3, indicating underutilization of available capability.
Inadequate termination criteria and progress reasoning: the episode ended with only 4/5 propositions completed and no corrective replan toward the missing subgoal.
improvement_suggestions: Explicitly encode and enforce the 'new chest of drawers' constraint so that different toy food items are assigned to distinct, previously unused chest_of_drawers targets rather than reusing chest_of_drawers_36.
Introduce a task-level progress tracker that ensures all object categories (fire truck, toy food, stuffed toy) are scheduled and attempted, preventing over-focus on a single subgroup like toy food.
Improve multi-agent role allocation so that when one agent is waiting, it is reassigned to pending subtasks (e.g., moving the toy fire truck or stuffed toy) instead of remaining idle.
Add checks after each subgoal completion to verify which propositions remain unsatisfied and trigger a replan specifically targeting the missing objects before the episode can terminate.
Refine reward shaping to penalize redundant rearrangements of already-satisfied objects and to positively weight progress toward untouched subgoals, steering behavior toward full task completion.
overall_assessment: The agents achieved partial progress by placing most toy food but failed to satisfy all task constraints and never handled the fire truck or stuffed toy, leading to incomplete goal coverage and inefficient use of both agents. Better interpretation of constraints and balanced subgoal scheduling are needed.
task_instruction: Move the toy fire truck to the chest of drawers. Put the toy food items in a new chest of drawers. Place the stuffed toy on the bed.
